notes:
Pass on the fake backend (gate exit 0): evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package. The card's entry symbol cryocon.cryocon:CryoCon was confirmed at cryocon/cryocon.py:209; the other entry symbols also exist (cryocon/tango/server/cryocon.py:98, cryocon/cryocon.py:131 and cryocon/cryocon.py:151). This package drives the first one.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's decision is direct-driver while its helper field names PythonObjectDriver; this package is a direct Driver (no family-config table), as the decision says, because the upstream interface is an object whose member descriptors return coroutines on the async connection and the catalogue action needs an explicit probe/location input schema. The mock_strategy preferred upstream-sim is not used: the upstream simulator is a sinstruments TCP device server (cryocon/simulator.py:107-157) with a handle_message surface, not the CryoCon object API the driver calls, and its optional dependencies are not installed; the clone is also read-only and must not be imported or run. The package fake mirrors the upstream CryoCon/Channel/Loop members with fixed placeholder values marked # placeholder in fake.py, and starts from values of the same shape as the simulator defaults.

The package is deliberately read-only. The upstream can write channel name, loop set point/type/range/gains, manual output power and control/STOP (cryocon/cryocon.py:151-185 and cryocon/cryocon.py:350-355); those are heating actuations at R2 or above, so this package binds none of them. Its only capability is cap.measure.temperature.v1 (class floor R0) and its risk is R0 (observational, no physical effect). No Limit is declared: there is no numeric write or invoke input and the action's probe/location inputs are strings. site-limits.example.json was therefore not needed and the exemplar copy was deleted.

NOT COVERED: the temperature-setpoint, loop type/range/gain, manual-output and control/STOP write paths; channels B to D and loops other than the first configured one are readable through the same descriptors but are not separate state fields; the hardware backend (native.py) was never imported or run and no hardware was attached; the other CryoCon models the README mentions are untested. The action converts K, C and F readings to Cel with the standard unit definitions and refuses S (sensor units) with MHS.DEVICE.PRECONDITION_UNMET. Every value in fake.py and test_driver.py is placeholder test data, not a Fact, a Limit or a reference. No human review or hardware test is claimed; driver.lock.json reviewed_by stays null. This is R0, so the loader's refusal of an unreviewed model-written hardware backend (R2 and R3 only) does not apply and is not claimed. G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is expected for a read-only package with no limits; every other CL3 test passed.
